bagPolicy.summary: Single-compartment bags, wallets, clutches and fanny packs smaller than 4 × 6 × 1.5 inches may enter. Medical and diaper bags smaller than 16 × 16 × 8 inches are exceptions.
allowed: Medical or diaper bag smaller than 16 × 16 × 8 inches
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: On-site general parking is included with the concert ticket; the operator offers an optional paid closer parking upgrade. Use the Meadow Brook parking directions for your event.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The Meadow Brook A–Z guide does not designate a universal rideshare pickup area.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Concession stands serve drinks; guests aged 21 or older may buy up to two alcoholic beverages per transaction with valid ID. Outside alcohol is prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible restrooms are by the VIP entrance, behind the main entrance box office and near the main concession stand. The amphitheater publishes separate accessible ticket and parking guidance.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: There is no re-entry into Meadow Brook Amphitheatre.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office at the main entrance opens at noon on event days and closes 60 minutes after the event starts. Guests with walking difficulty can drive to the box office to collect tickets before parking.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Use the main entrance or the VIP entrance indicated for your ticket; the show determines gate time. The box office at the main entrance opens at noon on event days.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
